image_description: A close-up view of a limbless, elongated reptile resting on gray concrete pavement. The creature has a cylindrical body with visible overlapping scales that appear textured and somewhat keeled rather than smooth. The coloration is a metallic golden-bronze or copper hue, significantly different from the expected pinkish-brown. A bright highlight runs along the dorsal side, suggesting a glossy surface, but the scale texture appears rougher than the 'smooth, polished' description of a worm snake. The head is not clearly visible in this crop, showing only a segment of the body.

The lines of the concrete slabs show slight warping near the bottom edge, though this could be lens distortion. It is minor but noticeable.
